title: Hickory Honeyed Chinese Corned Beef Char Siu Bao
description: A nostalgic twist on the classic Chinese char siu bao, featuring corned beef and a sweet hickory glaze.
instructions: In a large mixing bowl, combine flour, yeast, sugar, and salt.
Knead the dough for 10 minutes until it becomes smooth and elastic.
Place the dough in a greased bowl, cover it with a damp cloth, and let it rise in a warm place for 1 hour.
Punch down the dough and divide it into 8 equal pieces.
Roll out each piece into a thin circle.
Place a tablespoon of corned beef in the center of each circle.
Fold the dough over the filling and press the edges together to seal the bao.
Place the bao on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
Brush the tops with hickory syrup and honey.
Bake for 15 minutes or until golden brown.
